thread: Release engineering and evaluation data both improved this week. SafeRoute gives agent safety evals 40,000 labelled tool-call traces, and the new open-weight model ships as an optimised container on launch day. Between them, the cost of checking an agent shrank.

items.headline: Open-weight model announced with a day-one NVIDIA container
items.why: NVIDIA said the new model will be open-weight under an Apache 2.0 licence, and that it will ship as an optimised container in NIM on launch day. Neither company gave a price for hosted access.
items.connection: Licence and packaging arriving together is what makes a model usable the day it is announced.

items.headline: ETH Zurich releases SafeRoute
items.why: ETH Zurich researchers released SafeRoute, a dataset of 40,000 tool-call traces labelled for unsafe actions. It is released under CC-BY-4.0, and the annotation work took eleven weeks.
items.connection: A labelled set of unsafe tool calls is the missing half of most agent safety evals.
